LESSON: MUSICAL INSTRUMENTS

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Musical Instruments

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Musical Instruments. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify and name different string instruments used in music making, playing of different string instruments
2. identify string instruments visually and aurally in preparation for improvisation,
3. demonstrate the skills of playing string instruments to improve performance,
4. use locally available materials to make improvised string instruments to enhance creativity, e) use improvised string instruments to accompany song for enjoyment, f) use improvised percussion, wind and string instruments in an ensemble for enjoyment, g) use digital devices to record and play virtual string instruments for enjoyment and digital literacy.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify and name different string instruments used in music making, playing of different string instruments
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify and name different string instruments used in music making, playing of different string instruments. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. identify string instruments visually and aurally in preparation for improvisation,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify string instruments visually and aurally in preparation for improvisation,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. demonstrate the skills of playing string instruments to improve performance,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate the skills of playing string instruments to improve performance,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. use locally available materials to make improvised string instruments to enhance creativity, e) use improvised string instruments to accompany song for enjoyment, f) use improvised percussion, wind and string instruments in an ensemble for enjoyment, g) use digital devices to record and play virtual string instruments for enjoyment and digital literacy.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use locally available materials to make improvised string instruments to enhance creativity, e) use improvised string instruments to accompany song for enjoyment, f) use improvised percussion, wind and string instruments in an ensemble for enjoyment, g) use digital devices to record and play virtual string instruments for enjoyment and digital literacy. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Musical Instruments.
2. Explain Musical Instruments to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Musical Instruments.
4. Show that you can: identify and name different string instruments used in music making, playing of different string instruments
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Musical Instruments. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Musical Instruments important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify and name different string instruments used in music making, playing of different string instruments
2. identify string instruments visually and aurally in preparation for improvisation,
3. demonstrate the skills of playing string instruments to improve performance,
4. use locally available materials to make improvised string instruments to enhance creativity, e) use improvised string instruments to accompany song for enjoyment, f) use improvised percussion, wind and string instruments in an ensemble for enjoyment, g) use digital devices to record and play virtual string instruments for enjoyment and digital literacy.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
